predecessors.name: Tsardom of Russia
predecessors.text: Starodub and the Severia towns that swore to the pretender in June 1607, with Orel as his winter base

successors.name: Tsardom of Russia
successors.text: the Kaluga lands of the pretender at his death: Kaluga, Tula, Bryansk, Orel, the towns round Moscow that swore to him in 1610

ledger.x: 22 June 1607 (12 June Old Style): Starodub swears to the Second False Dmitry.
1607: 'several southern cities' follow Starodub and 'Северщина и юг с Астраханью' stay under his rule.
1608: Tula and Kaluga go over to the pretender.
1608: the pretender sets up his court at Tushino, 19 versts from the Kremlin.
1608: the northern and central towns swear to the Tushino court.
1608: the Middle Volga towns recognise the pretender.
1608: «На северо-западе самозванцу присягнули Псков и его пригороды».
The ru page says «Под властью Лжедмитрия II по-прежнему оставалась Северщина и юг с Астраханью» without a date for Astrakhan's oath; placed at the Tushino summit of 1608 as a bridge.
November 1608: the north turns on the pretender.
Late December 1609: the Tushino siege ends.
27 December 1609: the pretender flees Tushino for Kaluga and 'the entire Tushino camp' breaks up.

Summer 1610: many towns swear to him again. «Лжедмитрию II присягнуло население многих городов и сел, в том числе ранее упорно боровшихся с ним: Коломна, Кашира, Суздаль, Галич и Владимир»; «Его войска захватили Серпухов, Боровск, Пафнутьев монастырь и дошли до самой Москвы».
Late 1610: the Semiboyarshchina «изгнало воевод самозванца из Серпухова и Тулы».
By early September 1610 the pretender's forces «отбили у поляков Козельск, Мещовск, Почеп и Стародуб».

wars.name: Second False Dmitry's rebellion and the siege of Moscow from Tushino
wars.outcome: The pretender took Severia, Tula, Kaluga and, from Tushino, besieged Moscow for eighteen months; the camp broke up in late December 1609 when he fled to Kaluga, and he was killed on 11 December 1610.

wars.name: Polish-Russian War (1609-1618)
wars.outcome: Sigismund's September 1609 invasion made 'the majority of the Polish supporters of False Dmitry II desert him'; the pretender fled to Kostroma/Kaluga and was killed in 1610.

certainty.note: Every border here is a list of towns that swore allegiance; no page gives a line, and the ledger draws the sworn lands as admin-1 units or discs.
